info.title: VAT Rates by Country API Reference
info.description: Get VAT rates for a specific country including standard, reduced, and super-reduced rates. Covers all EU and major global jurisdictions.

servers.description: VAT Rates by Country API Server

get.summary: Get VAT rate by country code
get.description: Fetches VAT rates for a single country or state provided via query parameters.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: Specify the desired response format. Options: 'json' (default) or 'xml'.

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Country identifier in Alpha-2 (PK), Alpha-3 (PAK), or full name (Pakistan). Combine with the optional "state" query for sub-national VAT; values are case-insensitive and may use underscores instead of spaces.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Optional state or region in Alpha-2 (NY) or full name (New_York). Use with "country" for state-level VAT; values are case-insensitive and may use underscores.

200.description: Successful response with a JSON array containing VAT rate objects for the requested country or state.

400.description: Bad Request — Missing required country parameter

404.description: Not Found — No VAT data for the given country/state

NotFound.summary: No VAT data for the given country

ApiKeyAuthHeader.name: X-apiKey
ApiKeyAuthHeader.description: Pass your API key via the X-apiKey request header.

ApiKeyAuthQuery.name: apiKey
ApiKeyAuthQuery.description: Pass your API key via the apiKey query parameter.

VatCountryResponse.description: Array of VAT rate objects for the requested country or state.

country.description: Country identifier returned by the API.

state.description: State or region identifier for sub-national tax data.

type.description: Tax type for the location (e.g., vat or none).

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code for the country or state.

standard_rate.description: Standard VAT or sales tax rate as a decimal (e.g., 0.19 = 19%).

reduced_rate.description: Reduced VAT rates when the country defines them (EU/UK only).

super_reduced_rate.description: Super-reduced VAT rates for eligible categories (EU/UK only).

categories.description: Category-specific VAT rates, where defined (EU/UK only). Keys vary by country - not every category below applies to every country.

VatRateItem.description: Each item in the array represents a VAT rate object for the requested country or state.

VatRateDecimal.description: A VAT rate expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.19 = 19%).

VatCategories.description: Category-specific VAT rates, where defined (EU/UK only). Keys vary by country.

books.description: VAT rate for books, as a decimal (e.g., 0.07 = 7%).

newspapers.description: VAT rate for newspapers, as a decimal (e.g., 0.07 = 7%).

periodicals.description: VAT rate for periodicals, as a decimal (e.g., 0.07 = 7%).

broadcasting.description: VAT rate for broadcasting services, as a decimal (e.g., 0.19 = 19%).

error.description: Short error category or exception type.

message.description: Human-readable error message describing the failure.

path.description: API endpoint path that produced the error.

status.description: HTTP status code returned with the error.

ErrorResponse.description: Standard error envelope returned by the API on failed requests.
